title: Telemetry Evidence Rules
description: Minimum observability evidence for phase gates and production readiness.

rules.title: Production Paths Emit Trace Context
rules.description: Production request paths MUST emit TraceId, SpanId, and CorrelationId or runtime-equivalent trace context.
rules.validationQuery: Inspect OTel traces for representative production paths.

rules.title: Structured Logs Carry Request Context
rules.description: Structured logs MUST include request correlation fields and avoid raw PII.
rules.validationQuery: Sample production logs and verify correlation fields plus PII-safe logging policy.

rules.title: Service Health Metrics Are Reported
rules.description: Production services MUST report error rate, latency percentile, throughput, and availability metrics.
rules.validationQuery: Inspect metrics backend or dashboard export for required service health metrics.

rules.title: Gate Evidence References Dashboard
rules.description: Phase 5 evidence SHOULD reference the dashboard or query used to verify nominal monitoring.
rules.validationQuery: Verify release notes or evidence manifest includes dashboardRef.
